info.name: 📌 Voyage AI API (MongoDB)
info.description:
### About Voyage AI (MongoDB)

"Voyage AI provides cutting-edge embedding models and rerankers for search and retrieval"

Voyage AI, part of MongoDB, builds its own embedding and reranking models for RAG and search. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Search & retrieval**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- Voyage AI Account: [https://dash.voyageai.com/](https://dash.voyageai.com/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `voyage_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:voyage_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://docs.voyageai.com/reference/embeddings-api](https://docs.voyageai.com/reference/embeddings-api)
    
- Models: [https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/embeddings](https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/embeddings)
